name: Pi
tagline: Minimal, extensible terminal agent from Earendil Works, designed to be customized.
description: Pi is a small terminal agent harness with extensions, skills, prompt templates, and shareable packages. It supports MCP servers, multiple providers, local models, print/JSON modes, RPC, and an SDK, while intentionally omitting subagents and plan mode.

pricing.notes: Open source; model usage is billed by your provider or covered by your subscription.
